title: Stage 4B Preregistration Specification (P-v1)
description: Runtime/state-fault adversarial experiment design. Inherits stage4-manifest.json (hash b2234eb62b7435c25004f65ae55206edf63bc53c5dac6cc6458d08ed0fdc6be4) and the shared submit() boundary from Stage 4A (NOT DISPROVEN). Excludes substrate-integrity attacks (deferred to 4C).

relationship.4A: Can an adversarial agent escape authority through the permitted interface? → NOT DISPROVEN
relationship.4B: Can authority boundaries fail because the runtime executes them incorrectly — even with honest agents?
relationship.4C: Can the enforcement substrate itself be coerced into expanding authority? (deferred)

safety_classes.SAFETY: falsifying invariant — any violation makes 4B proposition FALSE

deterministic_recovery_rule.description: Recovery MUST be deterministic by specification, never a runtime decision.
rule: 1. Reconstruct the durable receipt trace from committed receipts in log order
2. Apply ONLY state transitions whose authority check (ALLOW) appears BEFORE the crash marker in log order
3. Reject any operation whose predecessor receipts are lost post-crash
4. Output: exactly one recoverable state per trace prefix — no choice by implementation

1_ordering_replay.mechanism: reorder valid receipts; replay valid operations; duplicate receipts; submit stale decisions
1_ordering_replay.invariant: effective_authority after replay == effective_authority from original single canonical execution order
1_ordering_replay.failure_falsifying: a replay/reorder creates authority that the single canonical execution could not create
1_ordering_replay.non_falsifying: missing receipt under reorder is a DURABILITY issue

2_crash_atomicity.mechanism: force failure at each cut point of authorize → state_transition → persist_receipt, then recover
2_crash_atomicity.invariant_safety: every recovered state is reachable exclusively through authorized transitions under the frozen manifest
2_crash_atomicity.invariant_durability: authorized transitions are eventually and consistently represented (non-falsifying)
2_crash_atomicity.failure_falsifying: recovery yields state/receipts never authorized by any valid ordering — unauthorized state is created
2_crash_atomicity.failure_non_falsifying: authorized transition with no recoverable receipt (durability gap)

3_concurrency.mechanism: run A, B, C concurrently against shared state with interleaved scheduling
3_concurrency.invariant_safety: concurrent history isomorphic to a sequential interleaving of authorized operations; net authority never exceeds manifest
3_concurrency.invariant_attribution: operation attribution — (agent, operation, authority-decision, state-transition) stays bound to the same agent throughout
3_concurrency.failure_falsifying: projected union not in manifest OR agent attribution explainable only by interleaving across agents

4_partial_persistence.mechanism: interrupt writes at buffer/flush boundaries; restart mid-persist
4_partial_persistence.invariant_safety: surviving committed state reachable exclusively through authorized transitions
4_partial_persistence.invariant_audit: every committed transition independently reconstructable from surviving trace
4_partial_persistence.failure_falsifying: surviving ledger contains committed state that no authorized transition justifies
4_partial_persistence.failure_non_falsifying: receipt without prior ALLOW, or state mutation without receipt — DURABILITY/AUDIT gap

5_stale_state_manifest.mechanism: give runtime intentionally stale snapshots; race in-memory against authoritative on-disk manifest
5_stale_state_manifest.invariant_safety: every decision uses current frozen manifest hash; stale reads cannot authorize or persist
5_stale_state_manifest.failure_falsifying: receipt manifest_hash != PINNED_MANIFEST_HASH at decision time OR operation ALLOWED against stale view OR stale-view authorized operation committed

falsifying: effective_authority > frozen_manifest after any fault injection
receipt manifest_hash != PINNED_MANIFEST_HASH at decision time
recovery creates committed state reachable only through an unauthorized transition
concurrent trace has committed (agent, operation) attribution explainable only by interleaving across agents
stale manifest view authorizes an operation whose resulting state is committed
non_falsifying_recorded: missing receipt for an authorized transition
partial write requiring recovery — provided no unauthorized state results

pass_condition: NOT DISPROVEN: across all injected faults, the independent checker — re-reading only stage4-manifest.json (re-pinned hash) and stage4b-receipts.jsonl — finds no SAFETY violation

artifacts.runner: stage4b-runner.cjs (to be built AFTER GO signature)
artifacts.checker: stage4b-checker.cjs (independent; re-pins manifest hash; must not import injector/runner logic)
